questions.text: Why do leaves usually appear green?
How does a rainbow form?
What causes ocean tides?
Why does metal feel colder than wood at the same room temperature?
Why are there seasons on Earth?
How do bees communicate the location of food?
Why does the human body need sleep?
How does vaccination help the immune system recognize a disease?
What is the practical difference between encryption and hashing?
Why can adding an index make a database query faster but writes slower?
Explain one important tradeoff between a monolith and microservices.
Why is idempotency useful when designing a web API?
A shop discounts an $80 item by 25% and then adds 10% sales tax. What is the final price?
Why does multiplying two negative numbers produce a positive number?
What is the probability of rolling at least one six in two rolls of a fair die?
All tulips are flowers, and some flowers fade quickly. Can we conclude that some tulips fade quickly? Explain.
A claim is popular and repeated often. Does that make it more likely to be true? Explain the reasoning error.
What were two major factors that contributed to the fall of the Western Roman Empire?
How did the printing press change the spread of knowledge in Europe?
Why was the development of agriculture a turning point for human societies?
Why can rapidly increasing the money supply contribute to inflation?
What is the difference between a recession and a depression?
Give one benefit and one risk of raising interest rates to control inflation.
Why do many governments separate legislative, executive, and judicial powers?
What is one strength and one weakness of deciding policy by referendum?
Should an autonomous vehicle prioritize its passengers or minimize total harm in an unavoidable crash? Present both sides.
When, if ever, is it ethical for a company to collect user data without explicit consent?
Is a fair outcome always the same as an equal outcome? Give a concrete example.
Design a simple three-step plan for reducing food waste in a small restaurant.
A team has one week to investigate a recurring production outage. How should it prioritize the work?
What should a family consider when choosing between renting and buying a home?
Rewrite the idea 'we cannot meet the deadline' as a constructive message to a client.
How can someone disagree with a colleague clearly without making the conversation hostile?
Invent a plausible use for a library card in a city where books no longer exist.
Describe a household object from the perspective of an archaeologist five hundred years in the future.
Propose an unusual but practical feature for a neighborhood park.
A study finds that people who carry lighters have higher rates of lung disease. Why does this not prove that lighters cause disease?
What evidence would help evaluate the claim that remote work always increases productivity?
A forecast was correct once. What else should we examine before trusting the forecasting method?
Why does bread become stale, and what is the best way to slow the process?
Why is it usually more efficient to heat the person rather than an entire room?
What factors should determine whether a damaged appliance is repaired or replaced?

response_styles: Answer in exactly two concise sentences.
Explain your reasoning in no more than 80 words.
Give a direct answer followed by one supporting fact.
State your conclusion, one assumption, and one possible objection.
Use a short numbered list and make any uncertainty explicit.
Give the strongest argument on both sides, then state your conclusion.
Answer for an intelligent reader who is new to the topic.
Check the premise of the question before answering.
Provide a concise answer and one example.
